strengths.point: Capital efficiency is high - the business earns well above a normal cost of capital.
Shareholder capital is compounding at a high rate.
Profit compounding has been strong over five years.
The balance sheet is effectively debt-free.
Reported profit is fully backed by operating cash.
The DCF puts intrinsic value well above the market price.
strengths.evidence: DCF intrinsic 6,514 vs price 1,392 - margin of safety 78.6%
Fundamental score 80/100 - multi-year sales uptrend; ROE 19%; ROCE 25%

strengths.point: Interest cost is trivial next to operating profit.
strengths.evidence: Operating profit 66 Cr vs interest 2 Cr = 33x cover (TTM)

strengths.point: Sales has compounded at a decent five-year clip.
The sales trend has been rising for 7 years in a row.
The reserves trend has been rising for 7 years in a row.
The return on capital trend has been rising for 4 years in a row.

weaknesses.point: Net profit fell year on year in the latest quarter.
Borrowings have climbed sharply over the last few years.
Margins contracted in the latest quarter.
weaknesses.evidence: Operating margin change -5.3 pp in the latest quarter

weaknesses.point: The stock has de-rated hard over the past year.
Earnings follow a seasonal cycle rather than a steady line.
weaknesses.evidence: CYCLICAL - strong: Jun, Dec; weak: Mar, Sep

weaknesses.point: Profit slipped versus the previous quarter.

weaknesses.evidence: Earnings acceleration -86.3 (YoY growth vs the prior quarter)

opportunities.point: A capex build-up is underway, pointing to future capacity.

opportunities.point: The price embeds less growth than the company has actually delivered.

opportunities.point: There is increased demand for lead acid batteries and the company's order book is very healthy.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "There is increased demand of Lead acid batteries and the company's order book is very healthy." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

opportunities.point: The mechanical processing unit of the lithium-ion recycling project is operational.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "The mechanical processing unit is operational and the second phase of hydrometallurgical output from the pilot plant is expected to commence operations soon." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

opportunities.point: The company's order book is very healthy.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "There is increased demand of Lead acid batteries and the company's order book is very healthy." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

opportunities.point: Free cash flow is positive and improving, funding growth without fresh debt.
The headline earnings multiple is low, leaving room if profits hold.

threats.point: A fast-growing debt load raises the stakes on execution.
Management noted that the cyclical nature of the lead industry and international price volatility can impact profitability.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The cyclical nature of the Lead industry and volatility in the international prices for Lead can affect the profitability of the company." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

threats.point: Management stated that a lack of availability of raw materials at economical prices could also affect profitability.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Lack of availability of raw materials at economical prices could also affect the profitability." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

threats.point: The company's major customer is setting up its own lead smelter which will affect total volume offtake and could impact sales.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The company’s major customer, Amara Raja Batteries Limited is setting up their own Lead smelter, and will commence operations in the coming months. This will affect the total volume offtake and could have an impact on the sales of your company." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

threats.point: Small size brings liquidity and volatility risk.
Historically weak quarters (Mar, Sep) are still in the cycle.

swot.verdict: Strengths dominate the evidence (S31/W12/O23/T10), led by 'Capital efficiency is high - the business earns well above a normal cost of capital', with 45 points of weight still sitting on the weakness, opportunity and threat side.
